candidates.sentence: Arrest?… our jails are full already and no warden wants a street cop to bring in an unidentified illegal… that ICE certainly will not come pick up…on a traffic misdemeanor.
The MOMENT local law enforcement is advised that ICE will actually come pick up arrested illegal immigrants, we will start arresting.
Within a month, the street will know that the gig is up and illegal immigrants will start leaving the country ON THEIR OWN.
In Congress, I will be a strong advocate of our 2nd Amendment rights.
As a Congressman, I will be an advocate for strong posture with Russia, and every other major oil producing nation across the globe.
Additionally, I support Trump’s promise to leverage China… and Mexico, and Russia, and every other sovereign nation which benefits from American wealth created by the sweat of our brow.
I will join the fight for a balanced budget amendment.
Port productions will provide federal tax revenue which greatly outweighs the price tag of annual dredging.
ICE must have a clear directive from Congress and the executive branch to enforce the law.
Our foreign policy interaction with Russia must ALWAYS bear in mind the oil and gas industry.
A balanced budget must be the top priority of a new Congress.
I support the Constitutional process to establish a balanced budget amendment to our Constitution.
I support a freeze of federal spending at contemporary levels coupled with a 1% decrease in spending across the board for 10 years.
I support the elimination of the IRS completely and the introduction of a 15% Federal Sales Tax.
Every small business could make it just fine if they had significant fat to cut and they cut it, then decreased spending 1% every year for 10 years.
Yes, I would support exempting food and medicine from federal sales taxation.
